<script>
var S = null, lastOk = 0, phase = false;
var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

function fit() {
  var k = Math.min(window.innerWidth / 800, window.innerHeight / 480);
  $('wrap').style.transform = 'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(' + k + ')';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', fit); fit();

function poll() {
  var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
  x.open('GET', '/esp-dash/api/state?_=' + Date.now());
  x.timeout = 2500;
  x.onload = function () { try { S = JSON.parse(x.responseText); lastOk = Date.now(); } catch (e) {} render(); };
  x.onerror = x.ontimeout = function () { render(); };
  x.send();
}

function cls(st) { return st === 'alarm' ? 'alarm-c' : st === 'ok' ? 'ok-c' : st === 'off' ? '' : 'warn-c'; }
function fmt(v, d) { return v == null ? '--' : (d ? v.toFixed(d) : String(v)); }

// Solarleistung als Sonne, die von der oberen rechten Ecke in die Wind-Box scheint
function renderPvSun(e) {
  var w = e && e.ok && e.pv ? e.pv.w : null, on = w != null && w > 5;
  // Strahlen werden mit der Leistung länger (bis ~1500 W)
  // ohne Ertrag (≤ 5 W, z. B. nachts) oder ohne Daten: keine Sonne, die Box sieht aus wie eine reine Wind-Box
  $('pvsun').style.display = $('pvw').style.display = on ? '' : 'none';
  if (!on) return;
  var k = Math.min(1, w / 1500), r0 = 30, r1 = 40 + 22 * k, g = '';
  g += '<defs><radialGradient id="pvglow" cx="248" cy="0" r="' + (90 + 80 * k) + '" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">' +
    '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffc400" stop-opacity="' + (on ? 0.10 + 0.14 * k : 0) + '"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffc400" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs>';
  g += '<rect x="0" y="0" width="248" height="320" fill="url(#pvglow)"/>';
  for (var a = 100; a <= 170; a += 17.5) {
    var t = a * Math.PI / 180;
    g += '<line class="ray" x1="' + (248 + Math.cos(t) * r0).toFixed(1) + '" y1="' + (Math.sin(t) * r0).toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (248 + Math.cos(t) * r1).toFixed(1) + '" y2="' + (Math.sin(t) * r1).toFixed(1) + '"/>';
  }
  g += '<circle class="disc" cx="248" cy="0" r="22"/>';
  $('pvsun').innerHTML = g;
  $('pvsun').setAttribute('class', 'pvsun' + (on ? '' : ' off'));
  $('pvw').innerHTML = w == null ? '--<small>W</small>' : Math.round(w) + '<small>W</small>';
  $('pvw').className = 'pvw' + (on ? '' : ' off');
}

// Screen 1 links: eine Box mit Batterie (groß) und allen Tanks als Balken
function renderSupply(s, b, f) {
  var tanks = (s && s.tanks) || [], al = b.st === 'alarm' || f.st === 'alarm' || tanks.some(function (t) { return t.st === 'high'; });
  $('tsup').className = 'tile t1 sup' + (al ? ' alarm' : '');
  var bp = b.soc == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, b.soc));
  var h = '<div class="httl">BATTERY</div><div class="hthr">' + (b.thr != null ? '< ' + b.thr + ' %' : '') + '</div>' +
    '<div class="sb ' + cls(b.st) + '">' + fmt(b.soc) + '<small>%</small></div>' +
    '<div class="sva">' + fmt(b.v, 2) + ' <span>V</span><br>' + (b.a != null && b.a > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(b.a, 1) + ' <span>A</span></div>' +
    '<div class="sbar" style="top:98px"><i style="width:' + bp + '%;background:' + (b.st === 'alarm' ? '#ff3030' : b.st === 'ok' ? '#00d000' : '#ffa000') + '"></i></div>' +
    '<div class="ssep"></div>';
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    var t = tanks[i] || { name: ['WATER', 'DIESEL', 'BLACK MAIN', 'BLACK GUEST'][i], kind: 'water', st: 'na' };
    var tst = t.kind === 'water' ? f.st : t.st;   // Frischwasser nutzt den echten Wasser-Alarm
    var col = tst === 'alarm' || tst === 'high' ? '#ff3030' : tst === 'warn' ? '#ffa000' : '';
    var p = t.pct == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, t.pct)), y = 136 + i * 46;
    h += '<div class="sr" style="top:' + y + 'px"><span class="n">' + t.name + '</span><span class="v">' +
      (t.l != null ? t.l + ' / ' + t.cap + ' l' : '') + '<b style="color:' + col + '">' + (t.pct == null ? '--' : t.pct) + ' %</b></span></div>' +
      '<div class="sbar tb" style="top:' + (y + 24) + 'px"><i class="' + t.kind + '" style="width:' + p + '%' + (col ? ';background:' + col : '') + '"></i></div>';
  }
  if ($('tsup').innerHTML !== h) $('tsup').innerHTML = h;
}

function render() {
  var offline = Date.now() - lastOk > 10000;
  var s = offline ? null : S;
  var status = s ? s.status : 'warn';
  var blink = s && s.blink;
  // quittiert: rot → orange, bis der Zustand weg ist (ein neuer Alarm blinkt wieder rot)
  var ackd = !!(s && status === 'alarm' && s.acked && !blink);
  if (ackd) status = 'warn';
  $('scr').className = (s && s.night ? 'night ' : '') + (blink && phase ? 'red' : '');
  $('dot').className = 'dot ' + status;
  $('stxt').textContent = !s ? 'OFFLINE' : ackd ? 'ACKNOWLEDGED' : status === 'ok' ? 'ALL OK' : status === 'alarm' ? 'ALARM' : 'WARNING';
  $('time').textContent = s ? s.time : '--:--';
  $('utc').textContent = s && s.utc ? 'UTC ' + s.utc : '';

  var b = s ? s.batt : { st: 'na' };

  var f = (s && s.water) || { st: 'na' };
  renderSupply(s, b, f);
  renderPvSun(s && s.energy);

  var w = s ? s.wind : { st: 'na' };
  $('tw').className = 'tile t2' + (w.st === 'alarm' ? ' alarm' : '');
  $('wkn').innerHTML = fmt(w.kn, 1) + '<small>kn</small>';
  $('wkn').className = 'big ' + cls(w.st);
  $('wsrc').textContent = w.src ? w.src + ' (avg)' : '--';
  $('wmax').textContent = "Max 10' " + fmt(w.max, 1) + ' kn';
  $('wthr').textContent = 'Alarm at ' + fmt(w.thr) + ' kn' + (w.win ? '  ·  ' + winLabel(w.win) : '');
  drawChart('warea', 'wline', w.hist || [], 248, 320, 120, 312, true);

  var a = s ? s.anchor : { st: 'na' };
  $('ta').className = 'tile t3 half' + (a.st === 'alarm' ? ' alarm' : '') + (a.act ? ' act' : '');
  renderAup(s && a.act);
  $('ast').textContent = a.st === 'alarm' ? 'ALARM' : a.st === 'off' ? 'OFF' : a.st === 'ok' ? 'ACTIVE' : '--';
  $('ast').className = 'hbig aw ' + cls(a.st);
  $('adist').textContent = a.act && a.dist != null ? a.dist + ' m / radius ' + (a.rad != null ? a.rad : '--') + ' m' : '';
  $('acloud').textContent = s ? (a.cloud ? 'cloud' : 'cloud offline') : '';
  $('acloud').className = 'hthr' + (s && !a.cloud ? ' warn-c' : '');

  var p = (s && s.baro) || { st: 'na', hist: [] };
  $('tp').className = 'tile t3 half h2' + (p.st === 'alarm' ? ' alarm' : '');
  $('phpa').innerHTML = fmt(p.hpa, 1) + '<small>hPa</small>';
  $('phpa').className = 'hbig aw ' + cls(p.st);
  $('pthr').textContent = p.thr != null ? '< ' + p.thr : '';
  var win = winLabel(p.win);
  $('pdelta').textContent = p.d != null ? (p.d > 0 ? '+' : '') + p.d.toFixed(1) + ' hPa / ' + win : '';
  drawChart('barea', 'bline', p.hist || [], 248, 154, 40, 146, false);

  renderEnergy(s ? s.energy : null);
  renderWeather(s ? s.weather : null);
  renderEngine(s ? s.engine : null);
  renderAnchorPage(s);
  renderSail(s ? s.sail : null);
  renderSos(s ? s.sos : null);
  renderAis(s ? s.ais : null, s);
  fitBigValues();

  $('msg').textContent = !s ? 'No connection to Node-RED' : s.msg;
  $('msg').className = 'msg ' + (s ? cls(s.status === 'alarm' && !ackd ? 'alarm' : 'warn') : 'warn-c');
  $('hint').textContent = blink ? 'Tap to acknowledge' : (s && s.acked ? 'Acknowledged' : '');
}

// ── ANCHOR UP: 1. Tipp = bestätigen, 2. Tipp innerhalb 4 s = systemweit einholen (Supabase) ──
var aupState = 'idle', aupTimer = null;
function renderAup(show) {
  var b = $('aup');
  if (!show && aupState !== 'busy') { aupState = 'idle'; }
  b.style.display = show || aupState === 'busy' ? '' : 'none';
  b.className = 'aup' + (aupState === 'confirm' ? ' confirm' : aupState === 'busy' ? ' busy' : aupState === 'err' ? ' err' : '');
  b.textContent = aupState === 'confirm' ? 'TAP TO CONFIRM' : aupState === 'busy' ? 'SENDING ...' : aupState === 'err' ? 'FAILED - RETRY' : 'ANCHOR UP';
}
function aupSet(st, ms) {
  aupState = st; clearTimeout(aupTimer);
  if (ms) aupTimer = setTimeout(function () { aupState = 'idle'; render(); }, ms);
  render();
}
$('aup').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (aupState === 'busy') return;
  if (aupState !== 'confirm') { aupSet('confirm', 4000); return; }
  aupSet('busy');
  var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
  x.open('POST', '/esp-dash/api/anchor-up');
  x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  x.timeout = 12000;
  x.onload = function () { if (x.status === 200) { aupSet('idle'); poll(); } else aupSet('err', 5000); };
  x.onerror = x.ontimeout = function () { aupSet('err', 5000); };
  x.send('{}');
});

// ── Wetter-Icons (inline SVG, 64×64) ──

    var a = i * Math.PI / 4, c = Math.cos(a), sn = Math.sin(a);
    g += '<line class="wx-ray" x1="' + (cx + c * r * 1.45).toFixed(1) + '" y1="' + (cy + sn * r * 1.45).toFixed(1) +
         '" x2="' + (cx + c * r * 1.95).toFixed(1) + '" y2="' + (cy + sn * r * 1.95).toFixed(1) + '"/>';

function renderAis(a, st) {
  if (!a) return;
  var W = 476, H = 320, cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2, ppm = (H / 2 - 14) / (aisRange * 1852), g = '';
  // Ringe bei ½ und voller Reichweite
  [0.5, 1].forEach(function (f) {
    var rr = (H / 2 - 14) * f;
    g += '<circle class="r-ring" cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + rr + '"/>';
    g += '<text class="r-lbl" x="' + (cx + 4) + '" y="' + (cy - rr - 3) + '">' + (aisRange * f) + ' NM</text>';
  });
  if (a.thr != null) g += '<circle class="ais-thr" cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + Math.min(W, a.thr * 1852 * ppm) + '"/>';
  aisPts = [];
  // Heading-up: alle Positionen/Richtungen um −up drehen (up = eigenes Heading, null = Nord oben)
  var up = a.up != null ? a.up : 0, ur = up * Math.PI / 180, cu = Math.cos(ur), su = Math.sin(ur);
  (a.targets || []).forEach(function (t) {
    var x = cx + (t.e * cu - t.n * su) * ppm, y = cy - (t.e * su + t.n * cu) * ppm;
    if (x < -10 || x > W + 10 || y < -10 || y > H + 10) return;
    var cls = 'ais-t ' + (t.stale ? 'ais-stale' : 'ais-' + t.st), rot = (t.hdg != null ? t.hdg : t.cog) - up;
    if (t.sog > 0.5) {
      var vl = t.sog * 0.5144 * 1800 * ppm, vr = (t.cog - up) * Math.PI / 180;   // Kurslinie: Weg der nächsten 30 min
      g += '<line class="ais-vec" x1="' + x.toFixed(1) + '" y1="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (x + Math.sin(vr) * vl).toFixed(1) + '" y2="' + (y - Math.cos(vr) * vl).toFixed(1) + '" stroke="' + (t.st === 'alarm' ? '#ff3030' : t.st === 'warn' ? '#ffa000' : '#00d000') + '"/>';
      g += '<path class="' + cls + '" transform="translate(' + x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + y.toFixed(1) + ') rotate(' + rot + ')" d="M0 -9 L6 7 L0 4 L-6 7 Z"/>';
    } else g += '<circle class="' + cls + '" cx="' + x.toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" r="4"/>';
    if (aisSel === t.m) g += '<circle class="ais-sel" cx="' + x.toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + y.toFixed(1) + '" r="13"/>';
    if (t.st !== 'ok' || aisSel === t.m) g += '<text class="ais-lbl" x="' + (x + 10).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (y - 8).toFixed(1) + '">' + (t.nm || t.m).slice(0, 14) + '</text>';
    aisPts.push({ m: t.m, x: x, y: y });
  });
  var oc = (a.ownCog || 0), oh = a.up != null ? 0 : oc;   // eigenes Boot zeigt bei Heading-up immer nach oben
  if (a.ownSog > 0.5) {   // eigene Kurslinie (COG, kann bei Strömung/Abdrift vom Heading abweichen), 30 min
    var ol = a.ownSog * 0.5144 * 1800 * ppm, orr = (oc - up) * Math.PI / 180;
    g += '<line class="ais-vec ais-ownvec" x1="' + cx + '" y1="' + cy + '" x2="' + (cx + Math.sin(orr) * ol).toFixed(1) + '" y2="' + (cy - Math.cos(orr) * ol).toFixed(1) + '"/>';
  }
  g += '<path class="ais-own" transform="translate(' + cx + ' ' + cy + ') rotate(' + oh + ')" d="M0 -11 L7 8 L0 4 L-7 8 Z"/>';
  g += '<g transform="translate(22 26)"><path class="r-nar" transform="rotate(' + (-up) + ')" d="M0 -12 L5 3 L0 0 L-5 3 Z"/><text class="r-n" y="24">N</text></g>';
  // Nord-Markierung am äußeren Ring + Ausrichtung oben mittig
  var nr = H / 2 - 14, nx = cx - Math.sin(ur) * nr, ny = cy - Math.cos(ur) * nr;
  g += '<text class="ais-nlbl" x="' + nx.toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (ny + 4).toFixed(1) + '">N</text>';
  g += '<text class="ais-up" x="' + (W - 64) + '" y="' + (H - 12) + '">' + (a.up != null ? a.upSrc + ' UP ' + String(up).padStart(3, '0') + '°' : 'NORTH UP') + '</text>';
  $('aisr').innerHTML = g;
  $('ais-note').textContent = a.own ? a.n + ' targets · range ' + aisRange + ' NM' + (a.alarms ? ' · ' + a.alarms + ' alarm' : '') : 'No own position';
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.aismodes button'), function (b) {
    b.textContent = { anchor: 'ANCHOR', cruising: 'CRUISE ' + a.cn, offshore: 'OFFSHORE ' + a.on }[b.dataset.m];
    b.className = (b.dataset.m === a.mode ? 'on ' : '') + b.dataset.m;
  });
  // rechte Seite: ausgewähltes Ziel oder Liste der nächsten/gefährlichsten
  var sel = aisSel && (a.targets || []).find(function (t) { return t.m === aisSel; }), h = '';
  if (sel) {
    var kv = function (k, v, al) { return '<div class="kv' + (al ? ' al' : '') + '"><span>' + k + '</span><b>' + (v == null || v === '' ? '--' : v) + '</b></div>'; };
    h = '<h3>' + (sel.nm || 'MMSI ' + sel.m) + '</h3>' + kv('MMSI', sel.m) + kv('Call sign', sel.cs) + kv('Type', sel.ty) + kv('Length', sel.len != null ? sel.len + ' m' : '') +
      kv('Status', sel.nav) + kv('Destination', sel.dest) + kv('SOG / COG', sel.sog + ' kn / ' + sel.cog + '°') + kv('Dist / Brg', sel.d.toFixed(2) + ' NM / ' + sel.b + '°') +
      kv('CPA', sel.cpa.toFixed(2) + ' NM' + (sel.tcpa != null ? ' in ' + Math.round(sel.tcpa) + ' min' : ''), sel.st === 'alarm') + kv('Last report', sel.age + ' s ago');
  } else {
    h = '<div class="hd">CLOSEST · TAP FOR DETAILS</div>' + (a.targets || []).slice(0, 9).map(function (t) {
      return '<div class="row ' + t.st + '" data-m="' + t.m + '"><span>' + (t.nm || t.m) + '</span><span>' + t.d.toFixed(2) + ' NM' + (t.tcpa != null ? ' · CPA ' + t.cpa.toFixed(2) : '') + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  if ($('ais-info').innerHTML !== h) $('ais-info').innerHTML = h;
  var showAck = !!(st && st.blink && (st.alarmKeys || []).some(function (k) { return k.indexOf('ais_') === 0; }));
  $('ais-ack').style.display = showAck ? '' : 'none';
  $('ais-info').className = 'aisinfo' + (showAck ? ' ack' : '');
}
$('aisr').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation(); if (swiped) return;
  var r = this.getBoundingClientRect(), x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * 476, y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * 320, best = null, bd = 22;
  aisPts.forEach(function (p) { var d = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = p.m; } });
  aisSel = best; renderAis(S && S.ais, S);
});
$('ais-info').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  var row = e.target.closest('.row'); if (row) aisSel = row.dataset.m; else if (aisSel) aisSel = null;
  renderAis(S && S.ais, S);
});
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.aismodes button'), function (b) {
  b.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    var x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/esp-dash/api/config'); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    x.onload = function () { setTimeout(poll, 1100); }; x.send(JSON.stringify({ aisMode: b.dataset.m }));
  });
});
$('ais-ack').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  var x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/esp-dash/api/ack'); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.onload = poll; x.send('{}');
});
$('ar-in').addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); var i = aisRanges.indexOf(aisRange); aisRange = aisRanges[Math.max(0, i - 1)]; renderAis(S && S.ais, S); });
$('ar-out').addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); var i = aisRanges.indexOf(aisRange); aisRange = aisRanges[Math.min(aisRanges.length - 1, i + 1)]; renderAis(S && S.ais, S); });

function winLabel(m) { return m >= 60 ? (m / 60) + ' h' : m + ' min'; }

// Verlauf als Hintergrund-Fläche. Baro: Skala mind. 1 hPa um den Mittelwert (Rauschen nicht aufblähen).
// Wind (zero): Skala ab 0 kn, mindestens bis 10 kn, damit Böen in echter Größe erscheinen.
function drawChart(areaId, lineId, h, W, H, top, bot, zero) {
  var v = h.filter(function (x) { return x != null; });
  if (v.length < 2) { $(areaId).setAttribute('d', ''); $(lineId).setAttribute('d', ''); return; }
  var mn = Math.min.apply(null, v), mx = Math.max.apply(null, v);
  if (zero) { mn = 0; mx = Math.max(10, mx * 1.1); }
  else if (mx - mn < 1) { var c = (mx + mn) / 2; mn = c - 0.5; mx = c + 0.5; }
  var d = '', first = null, last = null;
  h.forEach(function (x, i) {
    if (x == null) return;
    var px = (i / (h.length - 1)) * W, py = bot - (x - mn) / (mx - mn) * (bot - top);
    d += (d ? 'L' : 'M') + px.toFixed(1) + ' ' + py.toFixed(1);
    if (first == null) first = px; last = px;
  });
  $(lineId).setAttribute('d', d);
  $(areaId).setAttribute('d', d + 'L' + last.toFixed(1) + ' ' + H + 'L' + first.toFixed(1) + ' ' + H + 'Z');
}

function setCls(id, base, on) { $(id).className = base + (on ? ' on' : ''); }
function conn(id, dir, on) { $(id).className = 'cn ' + (dir === 'r' || dir === 'l' ? 'h ' : 'v ') + dir + (on ? ' on' : ''); }
function w(v) { return v == null ? '--' : v + '<small> W</small>'; }
function renderEnergy(e) {
  if (!e || !e.ok) {
    ['shore','inv','ac','pv','bat','dc'].forEach(function (k) { $('ev-' + k).textContent = '--'; });
    return;
  }
  var shoreOn = e.shore.on, solarOn = (e.pv.w || 0) > 5, acOn = (e.ac.w || 0) > 5, dcOn = (e.dc.w || 0) > 5;
  var invW = e.inv.w || 0, charging = invW > 5, inverting = invW < -5;
  setCls('eb-shore', 'eb r1', shoreOn);
  $('ev-shore').innerHTML = shoreOn ? w(e.shore.w) : '<span style="font-size:24px">Disconnected</span>';
  $('es-shore').textContent = shoreOn && e.shore.v ? e.shore.v + ' V' : '';
  $('ev-inv').textContent = e.inv.st;
  $('es-inv').textContent = e.inv.w != null && e.inv.w !== 0 ? Math.abs(e.inv.w) + ' W DC' : '';
  setCls('eb-ac', 'eb r1', acOn); $('ev-ac').innerHTML = w(e.ac.w);
  setCls('eb-pv', 'eb r2', solarOn); $('ev-pv').innerHTML = w(e.pv.w);
  $('es-pva').textContent = e.pv.a != null && e.pv.a > 0.05 ? e.pv.a.toFixed(1) + ' A' : '';
  $('es-pv').textContent = e.pv.today != null ? 'Today ' + e.pv.today.toFixed(2) + (e.pv.yest != null ? ' · Yest. ' + e.pv.yest.toFixed(2) : '') + ' kWh' : '';
  var mh = (e.pv.mppts || []).map(function (m) {   // einzelne MPPTs: Name, Leistung, Ertrag heute
    return '<div><span>' + m.n + '</span><span>' + (m.w != null ? m.w + ' W' : '--') + '</span><span>' + (m.kwh != null ? m.kwh.toFixed(2) + ' kWh' : '--') + '</span></div>';
  }).join('');
  $('emp').innerHTML = mh; $('emp').style.display = mh ? '' : 'none';
  setCls('eb-dc', 'eb r2', dcOn); $('ev-dc').innerHTML = w(e.dc.w);
  $('ev-bat').innerHTML = (e.bat.soc == null ? '--' : e.bat.soc) + '<small> %</small>';
  $('es-bat').textContent = fmt(e.bat.v, 2) + ' V  ' + fmt(e.bat.a, 1) + ' A  ' + fmt(e.bat.w) + ' W';
  $('es-bat2').innerHTML = e.bat.st + (e.bat.ttg ? '<small>' + e.bat.ttg + '</small>' : '');
  $('ebn').textContent = e.bat.n || '';
  var bh = (e.bats || []).map(function (x) {   // weitere Batterien (z. B. Starterbatterie), wie in der Pro App
    return '<div><span>' + x.n + '</span><b>' + (x.soc != null ? x.soc + ' %' : '') + (x.v != null ? ' · ' + x.v.toFixed(2) + ' V' : '') + '</b></div>';
  }).join('');
  $('ebs').innerHTML = bh; $('ebs').style.display = bh ? '' : 'none';
  // Verlauf der letzten 10 min als Hintergrund (Skala ab 0 W, wie Wind)
  drawChart('pvarea', 'pvline', e.pv.hist || [], 220, 172, 104, 170, true);   // Solar: unter Tagesertrag, hinter der MPPT-Liste
  drawChart('acarea', 'acline', e.ac.hist || [], 220, 110, 44, 108, true);
  drawChart('dcarea', 'dcline', e.dc.hist || [], 220, 172, 70, 170, true);
  conn('cn-shore', 'r', shoreOn); conn('cn-ac', 'r', acOn); conn('cn-pv', 'r', solarOn); conn('cn-dc', 'r', dcOn);
  conn('cn-bat', inverting ? 'u' : 'd', charging || inverting);
}

// ── Screens: wischen, Pfeiltasten oder Punkte; neuer Alarm → zurück zu Screen 1 ──
var page = 1, wasBlink = false, swX = null, swiped = false;
// Reihenfolge der Screens: Übersicht, Energy Flow, Tanks, Wetter, Motor, Segeln, Anker, AIS, SOS (VHF-Notruf)
var PAGES = ['p1', 'p2', 'p3', 'p4', 'p6', 'pA', 'p5', 'pS'], NP = PAGES.length, PG_ENGINE = 4, PG_SAIL = 5, PG_AIS = 6, PG_ANCHOR = 7, PG_SOS = 8;
function showPage(n) {
  page = n;
  PAGES.forEach(function (id, i) {
    $(id).style.display = n === i + 1 ? '' : 'none';
    $('d' + (i + 1)).className = n === i + 1 ? 'on' : '';
  });
  if (n === PG_ANCHOR) ancMapShow();
}
$('scr').addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { swX = e.clientX; swiped = false; });
$('scr').addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) {
  if (swX == null) return;
  var dx = e.clientX - swX; swX = null;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 60) { swiped = true; showPage(Math.max(1, Math.min(NP, page + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)))); }
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') showPage(Math.min(NP, page + 1)); else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') showPage(Math.max(1, page - 1));
});
$('d1').parentNode.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); showPage(page % NP + 1); });
setInterval(function () {
  var b = !!(S && S.blink);
  var ak = (S && S.alarmKeys) || [], only = function (p) { return ak.length && ak.every(function (k) { return k.indexOf(p) === 0; }); };
  if (b && !wasBlink && page !== PG_SOS) showPage(only('rig') ? PG_SAIL : only('engtemp') ? PG_ENGINE : only('ais_') ? PG_AIS : 1);
  wasBlink = b;
}, 300);

$('nbtn').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (!S) return;
  var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
  x.open('POST', '/esp-dash/api/config');
  x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  x.onload = function () { setTimeout(poll, 1100); };
  x.send(JSON.stringify({ night: !S.night }));
});

$('scr').addEventListener('click', function () {
  if (swiped) { swiped = false; return; }
  if (!S || !S.blink) return;
  var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
  x.open('POST', '/esp-dash/api/ack');
  x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  x.onload = poll;
  x.send('{}');
});

setInterval(poll, 1000);
setInterval(function () { phase = !phase; render(); }, 500);
poll();
</script>
